blocks.text: Abbotsford houses: 13 months of listings, sales and prices to September 2026

Over the 13 months from September 2025 to September 2026, listings of houses in Abbotsford peaked at 491 in September 2025 and bottomed at 293 in December 2025. Sales were strongest in June 2026 with 63. The reported sale price moved from $1,050,000 to $949,000, a change of −9.6%.

blocks.text: Abbotsford real estate market stats for September 2026: benchmark prices and trends

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Abbotsford?
faq.a: At the end of September 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 440 houses listed in Abbotsford and 45 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 10%. Month-end counts move daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: What is the reported sale price for houses in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The September report gave $949,000 for houses in Abbotsford, against $1,017,500 the month before. The reports give one sale-price figure and do not say whether it is an average or a median, so use it for direction, not as a valuation of your own home.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Abbotsford?
faq.a: The September report showed 39 days on market for houses in Abbotsford and a sale-to-list price ratio of 95%, against 30 days the month before.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in Abbotsford?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in Abbotsford?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
